decision: Mot bo doc dung chung cho trinh duyet (env-client.ts) voi cong fail-CLOSED, thay ba loi tu viet o ba thanh phan
impact: Loai phuong an 'kiem status===503 tai tung cho': proxy 502 va trang HTML loi khong bao gio mang ma ENV_STORE_UNREADABLE, ma bai hoc so 2 cua hop dong cha neu dich danh ba ca do. Doi lai: mot file moi va ba cho phai doi cach goi.

decision: Mot o do = mot tep test tron ven; KHONG o nao dung bo loc -t
impact: Loai phuong an gom nhieu ca vao mot tep roi loc bang -t. vitest -t khong khop gi thi thoat 0 va o do bao DAT vinh vien (do tren ho so cha 31/08: hai tieu chi khong co test nao ma ca hai o bao PASS). Doi lai: bay tep test moi thay vi ba.

decision: 76 khoa ja dang no KHONG duoc dich o goi nay; chung vao allowlist dong bang cua phep do parity
impact: Owner chot 01/09. Doi lai: no cu khong co lai o day, nhung cung khong lon them duoc va khoa moi dat nham namespace van bi bat. Loai phuong an chi so parity trong namespace moi — khoa moi dat nham cho se vo hinh voi phep do, dung lop loi 'phep do tu thoa'.
revisit: khi co nguoi dich ja, allowlist phai CO LAI — phep do da co khang dinh bat allowlist chi-lon-len

decision: Do o khoa tren node ABI bang cach EXPORT hook useNodeKeyGate roi renderHook trong ReactFlowProvider, thay vi render tron node trong canvas
impact: Doi lai: mot hook noi-bo tro thanh be mat cong khai chi vi phep do. Loai phuong an render tron node — muon toi trang thai o khoa phai dung mot Task FAILED co thong diep khop mau env-key, tuc phep do phu thuoc vao bo phan loai loi cua mot lop khac; hong o do thi o do do bao sai cho. Hook la vat that ma shell dung, nen van do ma san pham chu khong do ban sao.

decision: Them putEnvMap vao env-client cho luot ghi thuong cua man Cai dat, thay vi de man do tu goi apiPut
impact: Guard cau truc E11 bat duoc ngay lan chay dau: man Cai dat van goi thang endpoint o duong ghi thuong. saveEnvKeys khong dung duoc o day vi no hop nhat len mot luot doc moi, se hoi sinh moi khoa nguoi dung vua xoa. Doi lai: ba ham ghi thay vi hai — nhung van dung MOT tep goi endpoint, la bat bien guard giu.

decision: Tat runBaseline cho round nay (s4-args mac dinh bat)
impact: Baseline dung cay rieng o merge-base, cay do KHONG co node_modules. Do hom nay: mot cay co node_modules cu hon lan nang cap Node mang binary NODE_MODULE_VERSION 137 va vo; mot cay cai moi thi lanh — tuc bien la DO TUOI CUA LAN CAI, va cay baseline se phai tu cai. Do la nguon do-oan lon nhat. Doi lai: khong co so lieu 'loi nay co san tu truoc'. Bu lai bang executors.script.preflight_env — o do co san trong suite_keys, chay MOI round, tu phan loai ha tang vs hoi quy tren dung cay dang chay, va co y khong nap gi tu node_modules.

decision: Su kien mo man Cai dat thanh hang so co listener that (settings-events.ts), thay hai loi dispatch chuoi tran khong ai nghe
impact: Round 1 phat hien: hai be mat bi chan chi co MOT loi ra va no khong lam gi. E6 cua chinh toi khang dinh mot nut CO NHAN dung — nhung khong bao gio khang dinh nut do LAM gi. Nhan khong phai hanh vi. Da them khang dinh nut phai BAN su kien (10 ca) va khang dinh phia nghe that su MO man (1 ca), ca hai da chung minh chieu do.

decision: Ly do doc-that-bai thanh MA (ReadFailure), dich o bien hien thi thay vi chuoi tieng Viet trong lib dung chung
impact: Round 1 phat hien: env-client tra 'phan hoi khong phai JSON' roi ba be mat nhoi no vao o {reason} da dich — nguoi dung en/ja/ko/zh doc mot cau lai tieng. Dung khuyet tat repo da sua o mot tep ben canh. Doi lai: bon khoa moi x 5 locale + mot ham dich rieng.

decision: Kho-hong co MA LOI RIENG (STORE_UNREADABLE) thay vi gop vao MISSING_CONFIG
impact: Round 1 phat hien: phan biet cua resolveConfig chet o bien may chu — node re nhanh theo MA, nen kho hong hien ra man 'chua cau hinh' voi 0 o nhap va nut Luu bam duoc. Guard AC-6 cua ho so add-media-library bat ngay khi ma moi thieu cau o 5 locale.

decision: DOI KHUON thay vi va tiep: SaveOutcome.detail thanh WriteFailure (ma), khong con cho nao trong be mat cong khai cua env-client de dat mot cau chu
impact: Luat dung-va: vong 2 sinh lai DUNG LOP loi cua vong 1 (literal tieng Viet trong lib dung chung ro sang 4 locale) — vong 1 va duong doc, vong 2 tim thay o duong ghi. Sua tung ca hai lan la dau hieu HINH DANG cho phep loi, khong phai chi tiet sai. Doi lai: mot union nua + mot ham dich nua; bu lai trinh bien dich chan lop loi nay thay vi nguoi ra soat.

decision: E10 (design-gate tham khao) KHONG chay o vong nay — ghi thanh gioi han da biet, trinh o Cong 2
impact: Hai lan cho no chay deu hong theo cach khong lien quan san pham: qua duong chup cua bo dieu phoi thi thieu target (exit 4); boc tu chua co dev server rieng thi dist dir tam duoi build/ bi chinh '**/*.ts' cua tsconfig quet trung, lam pnpm typecheck do TS6053 — tuc phep do THAM KHAO pha mot lenh trong checklist commit. Gia vuot gia tri: no khong chung minh duoc gi ma E9 khong chung minh chac hon. Doi lai: AC-14 tua HOAN TOAN vao E9. Nguoi duyet quyet o Cong 2.

decision: Dong cuoc dua build/** <-> typecheck NGAY TRONG ho so nay: them "build" vao tsconfig exclude, giu nguyen cac dong build/*/types/** trong include
impact: Vong 1 do REJECT vi mot lenh suite (pnpm typecheck, TS6053) chu khong vi eval nao. Khoi Known limits do chinh nguoi ky viet 01/09 ket luan cach chua nam NGOAI ho so; do lai 02/09 cho thay ket luan do sai mot nhip — Next doc mang include, tsc doc exclude, nen hai tinh chat tach roi duoc trong cung mot file. Truoc: tsc doc 10 tep duoi build/. Sau: 0 tep, typecheck exit 0, lint exit 0, dev server NEXT_DIST_DIR=build/kkt-a11y khong lam Next ghi lai tsconfig.json (sha khop), 37 tep .next/types/** van trong chuong trinh. Doi lai: mot sua cau hinh CA KHO nam trong ho so T2 nay — bac rui ro khong doi (tsconfig.json khong thuoc t3_paths), nhung pham vi rong hon luc Cong 1 duyet, nen nguoi duyet nhan o Cong 2. Khoi Known limits da viet lai cho khoi tu mau thuan.

decision: DOI KHUON theo STOP-PATCHING-CLAUSE: gop `executors.test.build` + `executors.test.typecheck` trong feature_loop.suite_keys tro lai thanh `executors.test.build_typecheck`. Owner chon duong nay trong ba duong.
impact: Vong 1 va vong 2 do RA CUNG MOT LOP loi — tsc doc mot thu muc sinh-tu-dong trong luc mot tien trinh song song ghi vao do — chi doi thu muc: r1 `build/**`, r2 `.next/types/**`. Sua theo TEN thu muc thi moi thu muc la mot vong; do la dau hieu khuon giai sai, khong phai chi tiet sai. Bang chung ca hai vong deu la mot LENH SUITE do, con 14/14 roi 13/13 o deu PASS, va `pnpm typecheck` don le do exit 0 ba lan trong ngay. Khoa gop von duoc viet SEQUENTIAL ON PURPOSE cho dung cuoc dua nay (chu thich tai executors:); no bi tach doi 31/08 vi mot ly do khac (build bi cong cu giet nuot tin hieu typecheck) ma nay TOOL-KILL-RULE da che. Doi lai: mot luot build hong se lai nuot tin hieu typecheck di cung — chap nhan, vi tran timeout >= 600000ms plus truong killedByTool nay phan biet duoc 'bi giet' voi 'that bai'. KHONG pha ho so da ky: hai khoa le VAN CON trong `executors:`, chi thay doi danh sach suite_keys.
